snippet.title: Color Lim Trailer
snippet.description:
Color Lim is a post-apocalyptic adventure about a small slime on a journey to discover who they truly are.
Dive into monsters, explore a ruined world, and rebuild a village as your story unfolds.

● Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244430/Color_Lim/
